result.summary: The pedestrian environment is significantly compromised by a large shipping container blocking the right-side walkway and sightlines. The street lacks basic safety infrastructure such as lane markings, marked crosswalks, and adequate sidewalk maintenance, creating a disorganized and potentially hazardous space for walking.

hazards.name: Large Shipping Container Obstruction
hazards.description: A large shipping container occupies the right side of the street, completely blocking the pedestrian path and creating a major visual blind spot.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway, extending from the foreground into the mid-ground.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks at visible junctions or mid-block locations reduces pedestrian visibility and right-of-way.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire visible roadway width.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Debris and Narrowing
hazards.description: Litter and structural elements on the left sidewalk reduce the effective walking width and create minor tripping hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Left sidewalk in the immediate foreground.

interventions.title: Remove Sidewalk Obstructions
interventions.description: Clear the shipping container and debris to restore the full width and continuity of the pedestrian walkway on both sides of the street.

interventions.title: Install High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian crossing points and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Add Lane and Parking Markings
interventions.description: Paint center lines and parking lane boundaries to organize traffic flow and prevent vehicles from encroaching on pedestrian spaces.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is severely compromised by a large shipping container completely obstructing the sidewalk, forcing pedestrians into the roadway. The infrastructure is in poor condition, characterized by cracked pavement, lack of lighting, and significant visual obstructions that create a hostile environment for walking.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large shipping container completely blocks the pedestrian walkway, forcing people to walk in the travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground, occupying the entire sidewalk area

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: The shipping container creates a massive blind spot, preventing drivers and pedestrians from seeing each other.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the frame

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The sidewalk and roadway surfaces are cracked and uneven, creating significant trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right foreground

interventions.title: Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Remove the shipping container and debris to restore the continuous pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and repave the sidewalk to provide a smooth, ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and personal security for pedestrians at night.

result.summary: The street environment is characterized by narrow sidewalks with utility pole obstructions and a lack of marked pedestrian crossings. The wide, unmarked roadway and continuous on-street parking create significant visual obstructions and may encourage higher vehicle speeds in a residential area.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along both sides of the street block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the foreground and midground

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks are visible at the upcoming intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross without designated space or priority.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection in the midground

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are located directly in the narrow walking path, reducing effective width and accessibility.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right sidewalks in the foreground

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint high-visibility continental-style crosswalks at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with a continuous, well-maintained sidewalk directly adjacent to the roadway. There is no physical buffer between pedestrians and parked or moving vehicles, and no traffic calming or street lighting is visible in this segment.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian-vehicle separation
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the curb with no buffer zone, planting strip, or bollards to protect pedestrians from traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the entire length of the curb line

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars can obscure pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground where the silver car is parked

hazards.name: Degraded roadway surface
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven pavement in the roadway could pose a trip hazard if pedestrians cross mid-block.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway surface in the foreground

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Install a furniture zone or planting strip between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: If this were an intersection, curb extensions would shorten crossing distances and improve sightlines; mid-block, they can be used to create protected parking bays and space for trees.
